about: The Abbie's World family cast (Evan, 2026-10-23 09:52Z): each person young (in Daddy's memory places) and as they are now. Designed voices only (ElevenLabs Voice Design): never a clone of a real person. Shared by every memory place (school jump, Grace's basement, Moon base). cast.py design -> candidates.json; Evan picks on /studies/family-cast/; cast.py save -> voices; cast.py lines renders a game's lines. Looks are written character sheets for stylized storybook characters, never drawn from photos; 'evan' marks what Evan said, everything else is a placeholder for him to correct. Kid characters are voiced the way animation casts them: an adult voice actor performing a young character (ElevenLabs Voice Design blocks descriptions of children's voices, 2026-10-23).

characters.name: Young Daddy
descriptions: An adult voice actress in her twenties with a high, bright, slightly raspy youthful timbre, the kind who voices mischievous animated boy heroes; eager, quick and full of wonder. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer with a light, playful, boyish delivery, a grin in every line, a little breathless with excitement. Close, warm microphone.
characters.sample: Okay bub, stay right there. I'm gonna climb up, get every single ball, and throw them all down to you. Don't tell Mom, okay? This is gonna be the best night ever!

characters.name: Bub, the dog
characters.voice: none: barks and panting come from the sound library, not a designed voice

characters.name: Daddy
descriptions: A warm, playful American dad in his forties, gentle baritone with a smile in it, the kind of voice that tells great bedtime stories. Clean studio recording.
A friendly, relaxed man in his forties with a soft, slightly husky mid-range voice, curious and kind, quick to laugh. Close, intimate microphone.
characters.sample: When I was your age, there was this school down the street, and one night my dog and I went on an adventure. Want to hear what happened? Get comfy, this one's a good one.

characters.name: Young Mommy
descriptions: An adult voice actress in her twenties with a clear, bright, youthful timbre, the kind who voices clever, slightly bossy animated girl characters; giggly when surprised. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, light and musical, very expressive and curious, sweet and quick. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: No way, you climbed all the way up there? That's so high! Okay, my turn. Hold my backpack, and if anyone asks, we were just looking for a lost tennis ball. Deal?

characters.name: Mommy
descriptions: A warm, kind American mom in her late thirties, soft and clear mid-range voice, calm and reassuring with a playful sparkle. Clean studio recording.
A bright, friendly woman in her thirties with a gentle, smiling voice, expressive and loving, perfect for reading picture books aloud. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Look at you, you found another one! I'm so proud of you. Now let's see where this little path goes. Hold my hand, and tell me if you see anything sparkly along the way.

characters.name: Young Auntie Lexi
descriptions: An adult voice actress in her twenties with a high, bouncy, youthful timbre, the kind who voices fearless, funny animated girl characters always ready for a dare. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, sparkly and fast, full of laughter, a touch of playground rasp. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Race you to the fence! Ready, set, go! Ha, I won, I won! Okay, okay, best two out of three. And this time no shortcuts through the sandbox, that's cheating.

characters.name: Auntie Lexi
descriptions: A fun, upbeat American woman in her thirties with a lively, warm voice, the cool aunt who is always up for an adventure. Clean studio recording.
A bright, witty woman in her thirties, clear mid-high voice with an easy laugh, playful and encouraging. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Okay kiddo, here's the plan. We sneak past the sleeping dragon, grab the golden cookie, and get back before anyone notices. Are you in? I knew you'd be in. Let's go!

characters.name: Young Uncle Jeff
descriptions: An adult voice actress with a lower, scratchy, boyish youthful timbre, the kind who voices goofy, good-natured animated boy sidekicks who love jokes and sound effects. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer with an easygoing, slightly sleepy boyish delivery that suddenly gets excited. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Did you hear that? I think it came from the basement. Probably nothing. Probably just a monster. A tiny one. Okay, you go first, I'll be right behind you. Way behind you.

characters.name: Uncle Jeff
descriptions: A laid-back, funny American man in his thirties or forties, relaxed baritone, dry humour and a big warm laugh. Clean studio recording.
A cheerful, easygoing man with a friendly mid-low voice, great at silly voices, patient and kind. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Alright, champ, watch closely. The secret to a perfect paper airplane is all in the fold. One, two, three, and whoosh! Okay, that one went into the bushes. Again!

characters.name: Young Pearl
descriptions: An adult voice actress with a very soft, high, gentle youthful timbre and a slight lisp, the kind who voices the tiniest shy animated characters, then full of giggles. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, tiny and wondering, slow and careful, delighted by little things. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Is that a ladybug? It has seven spots. One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Can I keep her? I'll call her Miss Dots, and she can sleep in my shoe. Is that okay?

characters.name: Pearl
descriptions: An adult voice actress in her twenties with a clear, confident, youthful timbre, the kind who voices witty, slightly dramatic animated pre-teen heroines. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, quick and expressive, full of opinions and big feelings, warm underneath. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Okay, so technically it wasn't my idea. But it was a really good idea, and I made it way better. Anyway, can we please go back to the café? I want to see the secret door again.

characters.name: Young Georgia
descriptions: An adult voice actress with a bright, sing-song, youthful timbre, the kind who voices chatty, imaginative animated characters who narrate their own games. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, high and sunny, giggly and quick, a born storyteller. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: And then the princess jumped on her pony, and the pony could fly, and they flew all the way to the moon! And the moon was made of pancakes. Your turn, what happens next?

characters.name: Georgia
descriptions: A young adult woman around twenty with a relaxed, clear voice, dry wit and kind big-sister energy, like the cool older sister in an animated family film. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
A friendly, confident young woman's voice, expressive and a little sarcastic in a fun way, patient and kind. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Okay, little one, here's how it works. You hold the controller like this, press this button to jump, and this one to grab. Don't worry, I was terrible at it too, at first.

characters.name: Abbie
descriptions: An adult voice actress with a sweet, clear, breathy, very youthful timbre, the kind who voices small, wide-eyed animated heroines full of wonder; soft, as if sharing a secret. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, gentle and bright, amazed by the world, giggly and brave, soft American accent. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Whoa. Look at all the stars. Do you think there's a ranch up there too? With sheep and a little red barn? I want to go see. Will you come with me? Hold my hand, okay?

characters.name: Ani ("Ah-knee")
descriptions: An adult voice actress with a bubbly, slightly husky, youthful timbre, the kind who voices brave, funny animated best friends who always say let's go. Clean studio recording, warm animated family film.
An adult female cartoon voice performer, sunny and quick, giggly, full of big plans, kind and a little bossy. Warm, close microphone.
characters.sample: Abbie, Abbie, come look! I found a secret door behind the bookshelf, and it's purple, my favourite colour! I'll go first, okay? Hold the flashlight. Ready? One, two, three!

looks.skinNote: a touch warmer than Abbie, drawn light (Evan 12:18Z: the first pass was too dark)

characters.name: The grown-up on the street
descriptions: A gruff but harmless American neighbour man in his fifties, booming voice calling out from a car window at dusk, stern but not scary, like a cartoon crossing guard. Clean studio recording.
A deep-voiced, friendly-but-firm dad in his fifties shouting from across the street, surprised and a little exasperated, warm underneath. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Hey! You up there! What do you think you're doing on that roof? Get down from there right now, before I call your mother! And take that dog home, it's getting dark!

looks.outfit: windbreaker, leaning out of a station wagon

characters.name: The school janitor
descriptions: A grumpy old American school janitor in his sixties, gravelly voice echoing across an empty schoolyard at night, more bluster than bite, like a cartoon caretaker. Clean studio recording.
A tired, crotchety older man with a low, rumbling voice and a slow drawl, jangling his keys, stern but secretly soft-hearted. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Hey! Who's up on my roof? I can see you, you know! You come down this minute, or I'm calling the police, and then your parents! Go on, scram, and take your ball with you!

looks.outfit: grey work shirt, key ring, flashlight
evan: catches you in the secret ending

characters.name: The town steward (hex city)
descriptions: A warm, slightly proud town steward in his fifties, rich and clear voice, a kindly storybook mayor explaining the town to a child, unhurried with a twinkle. Clean studio recording, animated family film.
A friendly, bookish older woman who runs the town hall, bright clear voice, gently enthusiastic about numbers and neighbours. Close warm microphone.
characters.sample: Good morning! Two thousand people live in our town now. The fountains are running, the bakery is busy, and the ships are coming in. What shall we build next?

characters.name: A baker (hex city)
descriptions: A cheerful, round-voiced baker in her forties, warm laugh in her voice, up before dawn and happy about it. Animated family film, close microphone.
A jolly, booming baker man with flour on his apron, big-hearted and quick to laugh. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: The ovens are hot and the bread is rising! Come and get it while it's warm, everyone! Fresh buns, warm loaves, and a smile for every single one of you.

characters.name: A fisher (hex city)
descriptions: A salty, good-humoured fisherwoman with a slightly husky voice, telling tall tales about the sea, playful and kind. Animated family film.
A cheerful old fisherman with a weathered, sing-song voice, always talking about boats and weather. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Boats in the water, nets in the boats! The bay is calm today. Fish for supper, I promise you.

characters.name: A builder (hex city)
descriptions: A practical, steady builder in his thirties with a friendly, matter-of-fact voice, proud of good work. Clean studio recording, animated family film.
A capable, upbeat woman builder with a crisp voice, explaining how things are made. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Red clay tiles, fired in the kiln. These roofs won't leak and they won't burn. Now, who wants a second floor?

characters.name: A water carrier (hex city)
descriptions: A quick, chatty young adult water carrier with a bright, bouncy voice, knows every well and fountain in town. Animated family film, close microphone.
An energetic young man with a light, friendly voice, always in a hurry, buckets swinging. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: Running water right here on our street! No more long walks with the buckets. Splash!

characters.name: The teacher (Winchester)
descriptions: A bright, patient primary-school teacher in her thirties, clear and kind, always encouraging, like a favourite teacher in an animated family film. Clean studio recording.
A warm, upbeat young teacher with a melodic voice who makes everything sound like an adventure. Close microphone.
characters.sample: We have run out of chalk! Would you carry a box over from the noticeboard? Everyone has a colourful job today, and yours is the most important one of all.

characters.name: The librarian (Winchester)
descriptions: A soft, gentle librarian in her sixties, hushed and kind, speaking as if in a quiet library, with a smile in the voice. Clean studio recording, animated family film.
A calm, bookish older man with a low, soothing voice who loves stories. Close microphone.
characters.sample: Someone left a book on a bench by the school. Could you bring it back before it rains? Take your time, there is no hurry, and every good story will wait for you.

characters.name: The postie (Winchester)
descriptions: A chirpy, quick-talking letter carrier in his twenties, always in a hurry but friendly, bouncy and bright. Animated family film, close microphone.
A cheerful young woman postie, fast and sunny, whistling between sentences. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: I'm late! Please take this letter to the café for me? Every letter has a home, and you are the fastest helper I have ever met today!

characters.name: The gardener (Winchester)
descriptions: A slow, sunny gardener in her fifties, relaxed and earthy, patient as a tomato plant, humming between words. Animated family film, close microphone.
A gentle, sun-warmed older man who loves flowers, easygoing drawl, kind. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: The sunflowers need seeds. The school has a jar. Could you ask for it? The sun is warm and the soil is soft, so there is plenty of time to grow things.

characters.name: The scientist (Winchester)
descriptions: An excited, slightly breathless scientist in her forties, curious and kind, speaking quickly about discoveries, a friendly cartoon professor. Clean studio recording, animated family film.
A bright, enthusiastic woman inventor with a quick laugh and an inquisitive tone. Close microphone.
characters.sample: I lost my lucky magnifier! I think it is by the noticeboard. Can you look? Nobody has ever found it before, and I think we are very close to a discovery!

characters.name: A neighbour (Winchester)
descriptions: A friendly, chatty neighbour in his forties, easygoing and warm, leaning over the fence for a talk. Animated family film, close microphone.
A cheerful, talkative woman neighbour with a big smile in her voice. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: Bub has slipped his lead again. It will be on the common. Could you fetch it so I can catch him? He always finds the happiest spot on the common, wagging all the way there.

characters.name: The farmer (Winchester)
descriptions: An easy, cheerful farmer in his fifties, calm and friendly, a voice that smells of hay and sunshine. Animated family film, close microphone.
A warm, hearty farmer woman with a gentle country lilt, kind and unhurried. Clean studio recording.
characters.sample: The hens have been busy and the baker is out of eggs. Could you find a warm one and take it to the café?
